mission_01: Apply the power rule: d/dx[x^n] = n * x^(n-1) term by term.
The numerical derivative uses (f(x+h) - f(x-h)) / (2h) for better accuracy.
The second derivative is the derivative of the first derivative.
Use a small h (like 1e-7) for numerical differentiation.
The error between numerical and analytical should be very small.
